simple.meaning: הַרְאֵל (harʼêl) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “mount of God ; figuratively, the altar of burnt-offering.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 43:15. Its contexts include altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הַרְאֵל (H2025).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
